content:
# Sirach 24 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Sirach 24 | **Date:** 2026-03-17 | **Total Disagreements:** 18

---

## Disagreement 001 — 24:1 "praise her-own-soul / praises her own soul / sings her own praise"
**Verse:** 24:1
**EMET:** "Wisdom will-praise her-own-soul"
**LOGOS:** "Wisdom will praise her own soul"
**PNEUMA:** "Wisdom sings her own praise"
**Issue:** αἰνέσει — "will praise." PNEUMA's "sings" is a creative but non-literal rendering. ψυχήν — "soul." EMET/LOGOS preserve the self-reflexive "her own soul" (important: Wisdom has a soul). SOPHIA follows LOGOS.
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: "Wisdom praises her own soul" — present tense for vividness, as Wisdom's speech is reported.

---

## Disagreement 002 — 24:2 "glory / boast / glories"
**Verse:** 24:2
**EMET:** "she-will-glory"
**LOGOS:** "she will boast"
**PNEUMA:** "she boasts of herself"
**Issue:** καυχήσεται — "will boast/glory." "Boast" has negative connotations in English; "glory" is more elevated and appropriate for Wisdom's self-praise. SOPHIA uses "glories" to preserve the positive divine self-revelation sense.
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: "she glories" — chosen over "boasts" which implies inappropriate pride.

---

## Disagreement 003 — 24:3 "I came forth from the mouth of the Most High"
**Verse:** 24:3
**EMET/LOGOS/PNEUMA:** All agree on this rendering.
**Issue:** ἐκ στόματος ὑψίστου ἐξῆλθον — "I came forth from the mouth of the Most High." This is universally agreed upon as a key theological statement. No substantive disagreement.
**Note:** This phrase is the verbal antecedent to John 1:1 "In the beginning was the Word." The Word/Logos of John is the same as Wisdom/Sophia of Sirach.
**Resolution:** All agents: "I came forth from the mouth of the Most High." Unanimous.

---

## Disagreement 004 — 24:4 "pillar of cloud / column of cloud"
**Verse:** 24:4
**EMET:** "a-pillar of-cloud"
**LOGOS:** "a pillar of cloud"
**PNEUMA:** "a pillar of cloud"
**Issue:** στύλῳ νεφέλης — "pillar of cloud." All agents agree. The allusion to the Exodus cloud-pillar is intentional.
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: "a pillar of cloud" — unanimous.

---

## Disagreement 005 — 24:5 "circle of heaven / vault of heaven / whole vault"
**Verse:** 24:5
**EMET:** "The-circle of-heaven I-encircled alone"
**LOGOS:** "The vault of heaven I encircled alone"
**PNEUMA:** "Alone I walked the whole vault of heaven"
**Issue:** γῦρον οὐρανοῦ — "circle/circuit of heaven." EMET preserves the cognate: "circle... encircled." LOGOS uses "vault" as more intelligible. The circularity of the Greek is poetically significant. SOPHIA retains "vault" for clarity but notes the lost wordplay.
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: "The vault of heaven I encircled alone."

---

## Disagreement 006 — 24:8 "Creator of all" vs. "One who made me"
**Verse:** 24:8
**EMET:** "the-Creator of-all" / "he-who-created me"
**LOGOS:** "the Creator of all" / "he who created me"
**PNEUMA:** "the Creator of all gave his command" / "the One who made me"
**Issue:** κτίσας με — "the one who created me." The repetition of "created/Creator" in the Greek is significant: Wisdom is herself a created being, yet pre-existent. This theological tension (created yet eternal, v. 9) is present in the text and should not be smoothed over.
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: preserves both "Creator of all" and "he who created me" — the theological tension is intentional.

---

## Disagreement 007 — 24:9 "Before-the-age / From eternity / from the beginning"
**Verse:** 24:9
**EMET:** "Before-the-age, from-the-beginning, he-created me; and unto the-age I-will-not-cease"
**LOGOS:** "Before the age, from the beginning, he created me; and until the age I shall not cease to be"
**PNEUMA:** "From eternity, before the beginning, he created me; and to eternity I shall not cease"
**Issue:** πρὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος — "before the age/eternity." PNEUMA's "from eternity" is theologically apt but slightly different from "before the age." SOPHIA uses "From eternity, before the beginning" following PNEUMA as it captures the theological weight while remaining accurate.
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: "From eternity, before the beginning, he created me; and to eternity I shall not cease."

---

## Disagreement 008 — 24:11 "authority / domain / power"
**Verse:** 24:11
**EMET:** "in Jerusalem was my-authority"
**LOGOS:** "in Jerusalem was my authority"
**PNEUMA:** "in Jerusalem I held authority"
**Issue:** ἐξουσία — "authority/power." All three agree on the term; slight syntactic difference. SOPHIA follows LOGOS's slightly more elevated construction.
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: "in Jerusalem was my domain" — "domain" captures both territorial and jurisdictional sense of ἐξουσία.

---

## Disagreement 009 — 24:15 spice catalogue — "aspalathos"
**Verse:** 24:15
**EMET/LOGOS/PNEUMA:** All preserve "aspalathos" as an untranslatable term.
**Issue:** ἀσπαλάθου — a fragrant shrub, likely Calycotome villosa or similar. The term is correctly preserved by all agents. Galbanum, onycha, and stacte are also preserved across versions.
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: All spice names preserved untranslated as proper botanical/liturgical terms.

---

## Disagreement 010 — 24:17 "richness / abundance / wealth"
**Verse:** 24:17
**EMET:** "fruit of-glory and of-richness"
**LOGOS:** "fruit of glory and of wealth"
**PNEUMA:** "rich with glory and abundance"
**Issue:** πλούτου — "wealth/riches/abundance." EMET's "richness" and LOGOS's "wealth" are literal; PNEUMA restructures. The pairing of "glory and wealth" is theologically deliberate. SOPHIA uses "glory and abundance" — "abundance" is softer than "wealth" for Wisdom's fruit.
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: "fruit of glory and of abundance."

---

## Disagreement 011 — 24:19 verse numbering gap (v. 18 absent)
**Verse:** 24:19
**Issue:** In Vaticanus, v. 18 is either absent or conflated. All agents skip from v. 17 to v. 19 following critical editions. This reflects MS tradition, not an error.
**Resolution:** All agents: Skip v. 18; proceed to v. 19 as in critical editions.

---

## Disagreement 012 — 24:20 "remembrance / thinking of me"
**Verse:** 24:20
**EMET:** "my-remembrance is-sweeter than honey"
**LOGOS:** "the remembrance of me is sweeter than honey"
**PNEUMA:** "Thinking of me is sweeter than honey"
**Issue:** μνημόσυνόν μου — "my memorial/remembrance." PNEUMA's "thinking of me" is dynamic but loses the cultic connotation of μνημόσυνον (memorial offering). SOPHIA retains "the remembrance of me."
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: "For the remembrance of me is sweeter than honey."

---

## Disagreement 013 — 24:21 hunger/thirst paradox
**Verse:** 24:21
**EMET:** "Those-who-eat me will-hunger still / those-who-drink me will-thirst still"
**LOGOS:** "Those who eat me will hunger still for more / those who drink me will thirst still for more"
**PNEUMA:** "Those who eat me will be hungry for more / those who drink me will thirst for more"
**Issue:** ἔτι — "still/yet." All agents preserve the paradox. LOGOS and PNEUMA add "for more" which clarifies the positive sense (not: hunger from deprivation, but: appetite increases). SOPHIA follows LOGOS.
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: "Those who eat me will hunger still for more, and those who drink me will thirst still for more."

---

## Disagreement 014 — 24:23 THE KEY VERSE — Wisdom = Torah identification
**Verse:** 24:23
**EMET:** "All these-things are the-book of-the-covenant of-the-Most-High God, the-law which Moses commanded us as an-inheritance for-the-assemblies of Jacob."
**LOGOS:** Same as EMET structurally.
**PNEUMA:** "All this — all of it — is the book of the covenant of the Most High God: the Torah that Moses commanded us as an inheritance for the assemblies of Jacob."
**Issue:** PNEUMA adds the intensifier "all of it" and uses "Torah" instead of "law." The Greek νόμον is "law." "Torah" is more theologically resonant for this identification but introduces a Hebrew term into a Greek text. PNEUMA also uses a colon where all others have a comma — this correctly emphasizes the appositive structure.
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: "All these things are the book of the covenant of the Most High God, the law which Moses commanded us as an inheritance for the assemblies of Jacob." — Retains "law" but the note on Wisdom = Torah identification must be prominent in Council Notes.

---

## Disagreement 015 — 24:24 textual status (bracketed verse)
**Verse:** 24:24
**EMET:** Brackets the verse
**LOGOS:** Brackets the verse with different content than EMET
**PNEUMA:** Brackets the verse
**Issue:** V. 24 content varies across MSS and is bracketed in Vaticanus critical editions. All agents correctly bracket it. Content: a reference to the Pishon and Tigris.
**Resolution:** All agents: Bracket v. 24 consistently.

---

## Disagreement 016 — 24:29 "canal-ditch / canal from a river / canal"
**Verse:** 24:29
**EMET:** "like a-canal-ditch from a-river"
**LOGOS:** "like a canal from a river"
**PNEUMA:** "like a canal cut from a great river"
**Issue:** ὡς διῶρυξ ἐξ ποταμοῦ — "like a channel/canal from a river." PNEUMA adds "cut" and "great" which are not in the Greek. SOPHIA follows LOGOS.
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: "like a canal from a river."

---

## Disagreement 017 — 24:31 "make instruction shine / cause to shine / blaze like morning light"
**Verse:** 24:31
**EMET:** "I-will-make-instruction-shine like the-morning-light"
**LOGOS:** "I will make instruction shine again like the morning light"
**PNEUMA:** "I will make instruction blaze like morning light again"
**Issue:** φωτιῶ — "I will illuminate/shine." "Blaze" (PNEUMA) is more intense than the verb warrants. "Shine" is standard.
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: "I will make instruction shine again like the morning light."

---

## Disagreement 018 — 24:32 "teaching like prophecy / pour out like prophecy"
**Verse:** 24:32
**EMET:** "I-will-pour-out teaching like prophecy"
**LOGOS:** "I will again pour out teaching like prophecy"
**PNEUMA:** "I will pour out teaching once more like prophecy"
**Issue:** ὡς προφητείαν — "like prophecy." All agents agree. Ben Sira identifies his own teaching with the prophetic tradition — a remarkable self-understanding. Minor wording differences only.
**Resolution:** SOPHIA: "I will again pour out teaching like prophecy." — "again" (πάλιν) confirms Ben Sira positions himself in the prophetic succession.
